text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, during a meeting in the Trainer's Office
about our upcoming schedule...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—In other words,
it's only gonna get tougher from here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I don't train with a greater focus on efficiency than before,
it's only natural that I'll fall behind immediately.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll have "Parcae" formulate
a routine that cuts out even more waste.
choice_data_list: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To organize my thoughts once more,
I open the drawer to look through my past notes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (So light and airy...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Mm.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, something dropped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it was pointed out and I checked,
it turned out to be the hot spring trip ticket I won in the lottery a while back.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You hadn't used that yet?
choice_data_list: I just haven't had the right timing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or rather, I drew the raffle hoping to give it to Air Shakur... but not knowing what to do with it, I left it aside and completely forgot about it.
choice_data_list: Air Shakur, you're not going, right?
Air Shakur, you're not going, are you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Are you okay with this?
choice_data_list: Because it looks like you'll be busy for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or rather, the truth was that with Air Shakur constantly running on high alert, I couldn't bring myself to rest alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, couldn't we just go before things actually get busy?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We go now, finish our business, and head straight back.
No staying the night, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...That clears up all your worries, right?
Hurry up and get ready. We're heading out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...It's pretty impressive.
choice_data_list: Make sure you use the private hot springs.
Make sure you use the private hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ah~.
choice_data_list: ...Were you not planning on coming in?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's reserved, right?
If there's no one around, that's fine by me.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, see you later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...
choice_data_list: Feeling refreshed?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You're already done for the day?
choice_data_list: Stay in too long and you'll get dizzy from the hot water.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Part of it was not wanting to keep Air Shakur waiting,
but I didn't feel like bragging about something I did purely on my own initiative either.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever.
choice_data_list: Shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Walking the road to the station. A pleasant breeze blows against my flushed body.
choice_data_list: Thanks for coming with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.
choice_data_list: So you'll accept this gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well. I did come along with you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: For your sake.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't make exceptions.
This is strictly the bare minimum involvement.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It just means it's necessary so we can hit reset from here on.
choice_data_list: Reset?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah.
Three years was too long."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ever since the starting line, the dynamic between you and me has changed. I'll admit that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, there are moments
when I feel like I "understand" you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Like hell that'd happen.
I don't wanna think I get them, and I sure as hell don't want them thinkin' they get me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you're thinking about "what's ahead,"
you should throw away your biased predictive text.
choice_data_list: You're...
You are...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: She really is a diligent girl.
She really is a diligent girl.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm tellin' ya to cut that out.
choice_data_list: Okay, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I can keep working hard, right?
I can keep working hard, can't I?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if I told you to stop,
you wouldn't listen anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...The trains might stop runnin', y'know.
Hurry up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond between Air Shakur and myself...
